title: Alias / link map (zic-rs-alias-map-v1)
description: Identifier -> entry map (canonical zone hash, or link target + materialisation), with duplicated-byte-link accounting (jiff#258). Published contract scope: this pins the schema **identity** (the `schema` const) and the top-level object shape. Field-level tightening and full instance-validation against a JSON-Schema validator are a tracked audit-suite item (the core crate carries no validator dependency); see docs/schema-compatibility-policy.md for the versioning rules and tests/schemas.rs for the registry/drift guard.

schema.description: the immutable schema identity; bumped only on a meaning change
